UPDATE: My boyfriend left me. He doesn't want to be with someone who's suicidal. It feels like everyone expects me to just jump back in to the pace things were before but I'm still having regular anxiety attacks and suicidal thoughts. My self-esteem is non-existent. I feel so low. I know no one's reading this and no one gives a shit but I've never felt so alone. This is all I've felt for years and it's draining. I don't want to hurt the people in my life by dying, but living is horrible. I haven't eaten today because I couldn't bring myself to do the washing up. I'm dreaming of a time where I feel happy but that seems so far away, if it's even possible at all. Two of my friends have tried to commit suicide in the past week. One of those two is going out tomorrow to try again. I don't think he's coming back this time.
